parsed.post: Discarding the attempt to increase LR to 0.06 (1.0643 vs best 1.0449). It seems the DEPTH 4/ASPECT 48 configuration is quite sensitive to LR increases in this 5-minute window. Reverting to 8294a1a. Next: I will try a more conservative approach by adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to the best base.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (8294a1a) and adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to see if regularization helps stability/convergence.
